(c) Tree heights: the console log shows Julia warnings for heights 11.694866, 2.750052 and 8.340066, none equal to 1, so these fits are on non-unit trees. The warning says Julia's sd_phylo is on the raw branch-length scale (factor sqrt(height)); the R bridge multiplies the log-SD by sd_scale = sqrt(mean depth) (julia-bridge.R, the univariate and sd paths), and the observed 6.6e-11 to 9.5e-11 agreement with the correlation-form K at the reported coefficients confirms the reported coefficients are on the correlation scale. The emulated bug 'raw ape::vcv instead of correlation form' moves the oracle by 2.25 to 6.93, so a scale slip would have failed. Hence the claim holds for the bridge-reported sd_phylo on these non-unit ultrametric trees, not for Julia's raw-scale sd and not for non-ultrametric trees.
